about: Run train-final (owner, 22.10.2026): pre-training tokens that finish the 1B, built on the GPU pod by jobs/train-final.sh; @D@ is the run's data directory. Same rules as train-1: licence tiers, content rules, 13-gram decontamination against HumanEval, MBPP and GSM8K, dedup.

tiers.B: share-alike (CC BY-SA): excluded by the current policy
tiers.C: web crawl, dataset licence only (ODC-By): owner decision
